Priya: Heads-up — PR #3121 (kv-cache-refactor) is on merge hold. CI shows an intermittent failure: `kv_cache_shard9_test` on macOS smoke. Failed 2/8 runs this morning. Can someone triage/bisect? @Aisha @Leo

Aisha: On it. Do we have a failing log or a build link?

Priya: Link from buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/kv-cache/builds/4421 (fail on job shard9). Stack tail:
```
AssertionError: expected key present
  at tests/kv_cache_test.cpp:213
  evict_timer.cpp: line 48: timeout triggered while active iterator
```

ci-bot: buildkite #4421 failed (job shard9). Failed step: `smoke-macos-shard9`. Re-run available: `/rerun 4421 --shard=9`

Kevin: I can fire a targeted rerun. Do we want a straight rerun or a bisect across commits? Rerun is faster for immediate unblock.

Aisha: Can we bisect first to see when this landed? My hunch: eviction ordering change in the refactor. If we rerun blindly we may just normal-flake. I can run a local bisect with the failing binary range `abc123..def456`.

Priya: Good call. If bisect points to a specific commit we can revert or patch. Also need one approver to clear the merge hold after a green run + snapshot check.

Leo: I can act as approver after green + snapshot update. If Aisha confirms root cause we should prefer a targeted fix. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Quick local repro notes: reproduced in docker with `TEST_SHARD=9 make smoke-test` while `MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES=32`. Fail reproduced 3/5 runs. Minimal repro indicates race in eviction timer; adding a small sleep in `evict_timer.cpp` avoids assertion. Patch candidate: change `std::atomic` ordering + add guarded check before erase. Snippet:
```
// quick patch
if (iterator->valid()) {
  std::atomic_thread_fence(std::memory_order_acquire);
  cache.erase(iterator->key());
}
```

Priya: Nice. If patch is small we can land a follow-up fix PR and keep the original open until fix merges. I prefer not to unhold until fix merged.

Kevin: Triggered targeted rerun: https://buildkite.com/redwood/kv-cache/builds/4423 (rerun shard9 x3). Current status: 1/3 green, 2/3 failed (flaky persists). If bisect completes, I'll schedule more targeted runs.

Priya: Assigning: Aisha -> bisect + patch PR; Kevin -> queued targeted reruns; Leo -> snapshot/approve gate on green. I'll keep merge hold in place until we have patch merged.

Kevin: Noted. Ping me if you want me to escalate CI priority.

Priya: Also tagging @eng-oncall for visibility — this increases CI churn for the day.

Leo: Thanks all. Please drop the bisect results here when ready.

ci-bot: Note: buildkite agent reused same macOS host for shard9; consider isolating retry to a fresh worker if flakiness continues.
